multi_entity_note: Two parties: JingWei HengTong Technology (ShenZhen) (Party A) and ShenZhen JingWei Communication (Party B).
processing_note: Party B shall pay the license fee to the account designated by Party A before December 31 each year.

contract.document_name.rationale: The agreement names itself 'Intellectual Property Agreement' in the title, preamble and running page footers.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Extension is only by mutual written agreement; there is no automatic renewal and no notice period to prevent it.
